title: Adding Part Sales starts with what new part sales would get
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Three active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A}, {Sales-rep-B} and {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able, {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able and {Sales-rep-C} is ZZAUTOTEST Cara Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} shows "Sales Representative - Service Labor" {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Service Parts" {Sales-rep-B}, with no Part Sales field.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Starting screen: {Customer-A}'s page is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Customer, click the + and click "Sales Representative - Part Sales".
  2. Look beside the first field for the + button.
  3. Change "Sales Representative - Service Parts" to {Sales-rep-C}.
  4. Save the customer and look at its page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Sales Representative - Part Sales" shows last, reading {Sales-rep-B} (the person new part sales get today), with a remove x and the tooltip "Remove Sales Representative - Part Sales".
  • Step 2: the + is no longer shown, because both fields have been added.
  • Step 3: Service Parts reads {Sales-rep-C}; Part Sales still reads {Sales-rep-B}.
  • Step 4: the page lists, in this order, "Sales Representative - Service Labor" {Sales-rep-A}, "Sales Representative - Service Parts" {Sales-rep-C}, "Sales Representative - Part Sales" {Sales-rep-B}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S4-R6, S4-R8, S4-R9, S4-R10, S4-R14, S4-R19, S4-E2, read 19 Oct 2026. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R6: “Its menu lists, in this order, each field not yet added: "Sales Representative - Service Parts" and "Sales Representative - Part Sales". When both are added the + is not shown.”
  • S4-R8: “Adding Part Sales shows "Sales Representative - Part Sales" last. It starts with the person new part sales get at that moment (S4-R26), or "Unassigned".”
  • S4-R9: “The fields always show in this order: the first field ("Sales Representative", or "Sales Representative - Service Labor" once Service Parts is added), then Service Parts, then Part Sales.”
  • S4-R10: “Service Parts and Part Sales each have the remove x of S2-R8 to their right, with the tooltip "Remove Sales Representative - Service Parts" or "Remove Sales Representative - Part Sales". The first field has the + instead, while there is something left to add, and otherwise no button.”
  • S4-R14: “Picking a person, or "Unassigned", in the Part Sales field keeps that choice until someone changes the field or removes it. Changing Service Parts never changes it, even when both hold the same person.”
  • S4-R19: “The customer page shows the representatives with the window's labels, in the window's order: "Sales Representative" or "Sales Representative - Service Labor", then "Sales Representative - Service Parts" when added, then "Sales Representative - Part Sales" when added. An empty one reads "Unassigned". The Sales Representative rows show on every customer, whether or not the customer has an address. The other fields on the page keep today's rule of showing only when the customer has an address.”
  • S4-E2: “A Part Sales field that holds the same person as Service Parts stays added. It does not change when Service Parts changes (S4-R14).”
